tasks.short: Supervise student teaching, internships and research

steps.what: Supervise undergraduate or graduate teaching, internship and research work

tasks.design: Retain supervision, observation and feedback with the teacher. Existing student material can remain in {LMS}; this task does not establish a separate record-writing duty or a substitute for clinical or research supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: Students need situated guidance and intervention when work becomes unsafe or methodologically weak.
tasks.enabler_now: Feedback-drafting capabilities do not establish equivalent supervision or a safe reduction in observation.
tasks.still_hard: Judging readiness, detecting misunderstanding and responding to actual practice.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher can interrupt unsafe work and adapt feedback to the student's reasoning.
tasks.altitude: Supervision time and academic or clinical responsibilities remain unchanged.

reach.task: Escalate a student practice concern with observed facts

evidence.claim: Live supervision requires observation and professional judgement; feedback drafting alone establishes no supervision labour saving.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher supervision, excluding student labour, formal grades and separately described material preparation.
Teacher observes work and produces feedback during retained s1. No structured competence score or ready safety status is assumed.
Check native access to student material before future custom work; existing access earns no new saving. No recording or automatic student evaluation is introduced.
No software or maintained process is introduced, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Supervision settings, student needs and authorised scope
research_questions: Which supervision delays reflect missing information rather than necessary observation and discussion?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0. Routine and struggling students retain supervision time; no administrative baseline is invented.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Participate in recruitment, registration and student placement

steps.what: Discuss programmes, registration needs and placement interests with students
Enter and check student registration and placement administration details
Resolve registration or placement exceptions with students and responsible staff

tasks.design: Configure reusable identity and programme fields in student administration {OTHER}. The teacher checks the entered facts and retains recruitment dialogue and exception resolution; admission and placement selection follow existing authorised decisions.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated student and programme identifiers can be entered across administrative forms.
tasks.enabler_now: Native forms can reuse known identifiers and validate required fields.
tasks.still_hard: Understanding student circumstances and resolving programme or placement constraints fairly.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher recognises when an apparently complete form conceals an access barrier or unsuitable assumption.
tasks.altitude: Less repeated administration with student dialogue and selection authority unchanged.

reach.task: Resolve a missing registration field without making a selection decision

evidence.claim: Native student-administration forms may reduce repeated entry while dialogue and admission or placement decisions remain manual; the allocation is modelled.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation in recruitment and administration, excluding student effort, formal admission decisions and placement-provider labour.

Teacher obtains student identifier, programme, cohort, placement interest and missing-field questions in s1. In s2's 21 retained hours the teacher captures or verifies these plus required record fields; no ready eligibility or placement-fit code is assumed.
Existing student records are produced by normal registration work with unchanged capture; this design introduces no new student questionnaire. Missing data return to manual clarification within s3.
Test native forms before custom code. Existing prefills earn no new saving. No automated ranking, admission, placement assignment or student evaluation is introduced.
unknowns: Current repeated entry and student administration fields
research_questions: Can native forms reduce administrative entry while preserving accurate identity and equal access to exception handling?

already_counted.description: Field capture, validation and manual entry exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain forms and inspect incorrect student-record updates

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=40+21+30=91; gross 9 minus 2 upkeep gives net 7. High assumes repeated identifiers across forms; low removes only 2 hours, consumed by upkeep. Recruitment dialogue and exception resolution keep all time.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Select and obtain teaching materials and laboratory supplies

steps.what: Select materials and supplies against teaching needs and safety requirements
Prepare the purchase request for selected textbooks and laboratory equipment
Check received materials and supplies against teaching and laboratory requirements

tasks.design: Configure catalogue-based purchase requests in {PROCUREMENT}, reusing selected item and course details. The teacher still chooses suitable textbooks or equipment and checks delivery; budget approval and supplier ordering remain with the existing purchasing route.
tasks.previous_blocker: Purchase requests can require repeated entry of known catalogue and course information.
tasks.enabler_now: Native requisition forms can reuse item details and validate quantities and codes.
tasks.still_hard: Selecting pedagogically useful, compatible and safe laboratory resources.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher can reject a cheaper item that does not support the learning task or safe laboratory practice.
tasks.altitude: Less requisition entry with selection and receipt checking intact.

reach.task: Check equipment compatibility against the intended teaching activity

evidence.claim: Catalogue-based requisition forms can reduce repeated purchase-request entry while selection and delivery checks remain; the estimate is model knowledge.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher selection, request and receipt checking; purchasing approval, supplier ordering and fulfilment labour are excluded.

Teacher produces item or edition, technical requirements, quantity, course, need date and budget reference in s1 with all 60 hours retained. s2's 15 retained hours include quantity capture, catalogue matching, cost-code checks and exceptions.

Purchasing maintains catalogue identifier, supplier, unit, price and specification through existing work; no new supplier data collection is transferred. Missing matches require manual requisition entry.
Test native requisitions first. Existing catalogue entry earns no new gain. A checked request is not an approved purchase; external orders use the unchanged authorised route.
unknowns: Catalogue coverage and current requisition burden
research_questions: Can catalogue reuse reduce requisition time without ordering the wrong edition, unit or equipment specification?

already_counted.description: Catalogue matching, field entry and request checking

incremental.description: Maintain course defaults and investigate request mismatches

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1: B=100, R=60+15+15=90; gross 10 minus 2 upkeep gives net 8. High assumes repeated catalogue entry; low removes only 2 hours, offset by upkeep. Selection and physical receipt checks retain their shares.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Collaborate on teaching and research issues

steps.what: Collaborate with colleagues to address teaching and research issues

tasks.design: Retain collaborative problem definition and resolution with colleagues. Existing source material can remain in {DOCS}; this task does not establish a separate minutes or literature-summary duty to automate.
tasks.previous_blocker: Teaching and research issues require reconciling experience, evidence and competing priorities.
tasks.enabler_now: Document access supports collaboration but does not establish a shorter meaningful discussion.
tasks.still_hard: Reaching shared understanding and deciding who should act when views differ.
tasks.human_edge: The teacher notices a concern that was not expressed clearly and can change the discussion accordingly.
tasks.altitude: Collaboration time and institutional decision rights remain unchanged.

reach.task: Discuss a shared teaching issue using observed student difficulties
reach.learn: Clear problem framing and professional boundaries

evidence.claim: Collaborative teaching and research problem-solving retains relationship and judgement work; no distinct removable administrative step is established.

assumptions: Boundary is teacher participation, excluding colleagues' labour and separately described research retrieval or publication.
Participants produce and clarify the issue in retained s1; no complete structured issue brief is assumed.
Native source and communication access are baseline and should be reviewed before any custom work. No confidential proposals are uploaded to a model.
No new software or process is introduced, so upkeep is zero.
unknowns: Current collaboration formats and recurring issues
research_questions: Which delays reflect source-access problems rather than necessary professional negotiation?

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100, R=100 and upkeep=0. Straightforward and disputed issues retain discussion time; no automatic minutes or report baseline is assumed.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Reduce registration and purchase-request entry while preserving student supervision, resource selection and professional collaboration.
reach: Work with programme administrators on accurate student records and laboratory technicians on precise resource specifications
role.ambitious_version: A health-specialties teacher who spends less time repeating administrative fields and remains attentive to learners, safe resources and academic judgement.
